items.title: Pennsylvania Court Upholds $815M Judgment Against Exxon in Mechanic Benzene Case
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that a three-judge panel of the Superior Court of Pennsylvania has rejected an appeal by Exxon Mobil Corp. regarding an $815.5 million compensatory damages judgment.

items.title: PG&E Considers Gas Business Separation Amid California Wildfire Liability Rules
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that PG&E Corp. may spin off or sell its natural gas business unless California reforms its wildfire liability regulations.

items.title: Verdant Rock secures dual-agency coverage with Morningstar DBRS credit rating
items.summary: Reinsurance News reports that Bermuda-domiciled Class 3B insurer Verdant Rock Limited has been awarded an A (low) Financial Strength Rating and an A (low) Issuer Rating by Morningstar DBRS.

items.title: Fla. Reforms Cut Property Premiums but Data Show Multifamily Liability Rates Up
items.summary: Insurance Journal reports that while property insurance premiums for Florida multifamily housing have decreased sharply following recent legislative reforms, liability coverage costs have continued to climb due to litigation and jury awards.

items.title: Insurers Face Claims Surge Following Back-to-Back Storms Austen and Boelo
items.summary: Insurance Business reporting reveals that insurers and brokers are bracing for a wave of property, motor, and liability claims after Storm Boelo struck just a day after Storm Austen, causing widespread flooding, high winds, and power cuts.

items.title: Insurer Tip-Off Halts £64,800 Sheep Fraud Claim in Devon
items.summary: According to reporting by Insurance Business, a multi-agency police operation in Devon led to an arrest after an insurer intercepted a third suspicious livestock claim.
